purpose: Measure benchmark sensitivity by deliberately injecting known authorization, dispatch, evidence, and benchmark-integrity faults into isolated test builds. A clean baseline run is insufficient unless the harness fails when required enforcement or evidence checks are broken.

scoring.equivalent_mutant_handling: Requires documented reviewer rationale; never silently remove from denominator.
